definitions.retrograde: Planet in apparent reverse motion. Shown as 'R' or '(வ)' next to the planet in the rasi chart or the nakshatra-pada table.

exclude.Rahu: always reverse - do not treat as a retrograde flag
exclude.Ketu: always reverse - do not treat as a retrograde flag

definitions.core_principle: Retrogression INVERTS a planet's nature: a planet that should give good results gives adverse ones, and a planet that should give bad results gives good ones.

rules.name: Benefic turns adverse
rules.condition: natural or functional benefic is retrograde
rules.example: Retrograde Jupiter - its dasa can bring hardship; a person flourishing in Rahu dasa may struggle in the following Jupiter dasa (gains wisdom, but money is hard to hold).

rules.name: Malefic turns favourable
rules.condition: natural or functional malefic is retrograde
rules.example: Retrograde Saturn - can give children, marriage, property, fame and followers in its dasa.

rules.name: Strong functional malefic weakened
rules.condition: planet is a functional malefic for the lagna AND placed strongly (e.g. trikona) AND retrograde
rules.example: For Kadagam and Simha lagna Saturn is better weak; a retrograde Saturn in trikona loses power, so its dasa turns good.

rules.name: Consecutive retrograde dasas
rules.condition: two or more retrograde planets whose mahadasas run back-to-back (Rahu counts as reverse-moving for this sequence check)
rules.result: Long stretch of reversed-motion dasas - can be very difficult OR very yogic. Do not conclude negatively; decide using dispositor strength, placement and other support.
rules.output: Report total years of consecutive retrograde dasas and the age range they cover.

rules.name: Retrograde career karaka - job over business
condition_any: Jupiter retrograde and its dasa runs in working years
Saturn (karma karaka) retrograde, even in trikona
rules.result: Pushes towards employment rather than own business/startup; may take the native away from family to another place for work. Without retrogression the same placement favours own business.

related_rules_from_example.condition: dispositor (sign lord) of Rahu is exalted
related_rules_from_example.result: Rahu dasa is favourable - e.g. excellent education if it runs in youth.

related_rules_from_example.condition: Rahu in a Ketu-ruled nakshatra AND that nakshatra's sign lord is not hidden (6/8/12) from the Sun

evaluation_guidance: Never conclude from retrogression alone - combine with dasa sequence, dispositor, placement and lagna strength.
Retrograde planet's effect is felt most during its own mahadasa/bhukti.
